anime.name: Solo Leveling
anime.description: In a world where hunters, humans with magical powers, battle deadly monsters, a notoriously weak hunter named Sung Jin-woo is granted a miraculous quest that allows him to level up indefinitely, rising from the weakest E-rank to an unstoppable shadow monarch.

episodes.title: I'm Used to It
episodes.description: Jin-woo enters a low-rank dungeon with his raid party, only to discover a terrifying hidden double dungeon sealed inside with godlike statues.

episodes.title: If I Had One More Chance
episodes.description: Trapped in the Cartenon Temple, the remaining hunters attempt to decipher the commandments of the terrifying Stone God.

episodes.title: It's Like a Game
episodes.description: Jin-woo wakes up in a hospital bed to find a floating quest window only he can see, initiating his daily training regimen.

episodes.title: I've Gotta Get Stronger
episodes.description: Jin-woo enters an instant dungeon in Hapjeong Station to test his newfound stats against vicious wolf monsters.

episodes.title: A Pretty Good Deal
episodes.description: Jin-woo joins Hwang Dong-suk's strike team as dead weight filler to enter a C-Rank dungeon, but betrayal lurks within.

episodes.title: The Real Hunt Begins
episodes.description: Cornered by the treacherous strike squad, the System forces Jin-woo into a brutal life-or-death decision.

episodes.title: You Aren't E-Rank, Are You?
episodes.description: Sung Jin-woo steps onto the international hunter stage as high rank scouts begin noticing his extraordinary aura.

episodes.title: Red Gate Survival
episodes.description: A routine White Tiger training mission takes a catastrophic turn when a gate suddenly transforms into a freezing death zone.

episodes.title: Monarch of Shadows
episodes.description: In the depths of the icy throne room, Jin-woo faces the fearsome Ice Elves and summons his first true Shadow Army.

anime.name: Jujutsu Kaisen
anime.description: A boy swallows a cursed talisman - the finger of a demon - and becomes cursed himself. He enters a shaman's school to be able to locate the demon's other body parts and exorcise himself.

episodes.title: Ryomen Sukuna
episodes.description: Yuji Itadori encounters Megumi Fushiguro and makes the fateful choice to ingest a special grade cursed object.

episodes.title: For Myself
episodes.description: Satoru Gojo takes Yuji to Tokyo Jujutsu High, where the principal tests Yuji's true conviction to protect humanity.

episodes.title: Girl of Steel
episodes.description: Yuji and Megumi meet the third first-year student, Nobara Kugisaki, before being dispatched to Roppongi.

episodes.title: Curse Womb Must Die
episodes.description: The first-years face a lethal special grade curse at Eishu Detention Center, forcing Yuji to relinquish control to Sukuna.

episodes.title: Hidden Inventory
episodes.description: In 2006, Gojo and Geto receive a critical mission from Master Tengen to protect the Star Plasma Vessel.

episodes.title: Shibuya Incident - Gate Open
episodes.description: On October 31st, a massive curtain drops over Shibuya, trapping thousands of civilians as curses execute their plot.

anime.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
anime.description: Tanjiro Kamado sets out on a perilous path to avenge his slaughtered family and find a cure to turn his demon-transformed sister Nezuko back into a human.

episodes.title: Cruelty
episodes.description: Tanjiro returns to his mountain home to discover horrific tragedy and encounters the Water Hashira, Giyu Tomioka.

episodes.title: Trainer Sakonji Urokodaki
episodes.description: Tanjiro carries Nezuko in a basket and undergoes grueling training on Mt. Sagiri to master Water Breathing.

episodes.title: Hinokami
episodes.description: Tanjiro and Nezuko confront Rui of the Twelve Kizuki on Mount Natagumo in an unforgettable breath-taking battle.

episodes.title: Sound Hashira Tengen Uzui
episodes.description: Tengen Uzui recruits Tanjiro, Zenitsu, and Inosuke for an undercover infiltration deep into Yoshiwara.

episodes.title: Never Give Up
episodes.description: The fierce clash against Upper Rank Six Gyutaro and Daki reaches a climax of flashy thunder and flaming blades.

anime.name: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
anime.description: An elf mage and her companions defeat the Demon King, bringing peace to the land. After fifty years pass, she embarks on a new voyage to understand the fragile meaning of human fleeting lives.

episodes.title: The Journey's End
episodes.description: After celebrating their victory, Frieren leaves for half a century and returns to find her dear friend Himmel aged with wisdom.

episodes.title: It Didn't Have to Be Magic
episodes.description: Frieren mentors Fern in basic spellcasting while collecting eccentric folk magic spells across quaint peaceful villages.

episodes.title: The Land Where Souls Rest
episodes.description: Flamme's ancient grimoire reveals the location of Ende, the northernmost kingdom where heaven meets the earth.

anime.name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
anime.description: A street kid trying to survive in a technology and body modification-obsessed city of the future decides to stay alive by becoming an edgerunner: a mercenary outlaw known as a cyberpunk.

episodes.title: Let You Down
episodes.description: David Martinez endures the harsh economic brutality of Santo Domingo until a sudden drive-by tragedy shatters his life.

episodes.title: Like a Boy
episodes.description: Equipped with a military-grade Sandevistan cyberware spine, David crosses paths with mysterious netrunner Lucy on a metro train.

episodes.title: Smooth Criminal
episodes.description: Maine invites David to prove his worth on a high-stakes corporate data heist against Arasaka executives.

anime.name: Attack on Titan
anime.description: After his hometown is destroyed and his mother is killed, young Eren Jaeger vows to cleanse the earth of the giant humanoid Titans that have brought humanity to the brink of extinction.

episodes.title: To You, in 2000 Years
episodes.description: A colossal titan appears out of thin air and breaches Wall Maria, shattering a century of fragile peace.

episodes.title: That Day
episodes.description: Eren, Mikasa, and Armin enlist in the 104th Training Corps to master the Omni-Directional Mobility Gear.

episodes.title: Beast Titan
episodes.description: Titans are spotted within Wall Rose, and a strange talking furred beast emerges from the wilderness.

anime.name: Chainsaw Man
anime.description: Denji is a teenage boy living with a Chainsaw Devil named Pochita. When betrayed by the yakuza, he makes a contract to be reborn as a devil-human hybrid known as Chainsaw Man.

episodes.title: Dog & Chainsaw
episodes.description: Denji lives in poverty paying off his deceased father's debts before merging with Pochita during an ambush.

episodes.title: Arrival in Tokyo
episodes.description: Makima introduces Denji to Aki Hayakawa and partners him with the wild Blood Fiend, Power.

anime.name: SPY x FAMILY
anime.description: A master spy known as Twilight must fabricate an undercover family for his mission, unaware that his chosen wife is a deadly assassin and his adopted daughter is a telepath who reads minds.

episodes.title: Operation Strix
episodes.description: Agent Twilight adopts Anya from a run-down orphanage to prepare for entrance into prestigious Eden Academy.

episodes.title: Secure a Wife
episodes.description: Loid Forger meets Yor Briar at a dressmaker boutique as both need a partner for high-stakes social events.
